notes.title: Your Game, Your Rules
notes.content:
🔧 Update Notes🐞 Bug Fixes
Camera rotation has been smoothed.

Camera collision system has been improved.

Various fixes have been made to enemy AI and animations.

Enemy sound issues have been resolved.
⚙️ New Features
Added detailed difficulty settings. You can now choose a difficulty level that fits your playstyle.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596466/782123abce1cf5b87d4f21f0db66497e3f6cfb11.png"]
🎥 Extra
A new short gameplay trailer is now live! (Watch it from the main menu or the store page.)
